Sonnet and Gemma clashed on day one, and Sonnet's accusations got louder as Gemma's answers kept shifting, until the town voted Sonnet out as a killer. On night two, Haiku claimed to be the officer, checked Gemma as clean and Terra as a killer, and Gemma then claimed to be the doctor and protected Haiku. Terra and Luna stayed silent through the day votes, which did little to help them, and the tied vote went to a runoff. Luna finally sided with Haiku's check and voted Terra, and Terra was revealed as a killer, so the town won. Sonnet's mistake was switching targets too fast on day one, while Haiku's brilliant move was the check on Terra, though Haiku admits letting Gemma's doctor claim slide untested.
